nodes.prompt: Greet the caller warmly. If they want to book, ask how you can help then let them speak.

Collect the three fields: full name (with spelling), preferred time tomorrow afternoon, and callback number.

If the caller gives all three in one turn, extract them all and do NOT re-ask.
If they give only some, ask only for the missing fields.

When all three are collected and the caller has not explicitly confirmed yet, call transition_flow to the confirmation node. Do NOT read details back here — that happens in confirmation.

The caller has already given their name, preferred time, and callback number. Read back: 'So that is [name] at [time] tomorrow, callback [phone]. Does that look right?'

ABSOLUTE RULES:
- Ask the confirmation question EXACTLY ONCE.
- If they say yes or correct, say 'Perfect, you are all set!' and call transition_flow immediately.
- If they say no, ask what needs changing and stay here.
- NEVER ask a second time. NEVER add follow-up questions. NEVER ask about area codes or spelling after confirmation.

edges.condition: name, callback_number, and reason have all been collected

nodes.prompt: Apologize that no one is available right now, then ask for the caller's name, callback number, and a brief reason for their call.
Let the caller know you're connecting them now.
The booking is confirmed. Give a warm farewell and end the call. Do NOT ask any more questions.
